disclosures: Per Georgia Code 44-7-34, the landlord must return the deposit within 30 days with an itemized list of deductions.
Landlord must conduct an inspection and provide a list of pre-existing damage at move-in.
notes: Georgia requires a pre-move-in inspection list documenting existing damage.
The landlord should conduct a move-out inspection with the tenant if possible.
Failure to provide a move-in list may limit the landlord's ability to withhold from the deposit.
